name: mcp-ops-tools-and-tracing
title: MCP ops tools and command-trace integration
description: Expose the simulated cluster via MCP: kubectl_get / describe_resource / get_pod_logs / helm_status wrappers over render_command()/resource_snapshot(), and record every tools/call as a CommandTrace under a new 'mcp' command family so unsupported MCP calls land in the /v1/debug/unsupported backlog and debug UI.
